1. (Original) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide.

2. (Original) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Original) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Original) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 or claim 4 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

9. (Original) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Original) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one targeted enzyme, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one targeted enzyme and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide and the at least one targeted enzyme.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Original) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast and the polynucleotide encodes at least one targeted enzyme.

18. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Original) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product within the non-native compartment; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product, wherein the product is selected from the group consisting of a bioactive product, a drug, a drug precursor, a biofuel, a precursor of biofuel production, and a detoxified or degraded substrate.

22. (Original) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product.

23. (Original) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

24. (Original) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

25. (Original) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

26. (Original) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

27. (Original) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of non-native compartments.
